text:
anya: Quick proposal — add a 'staged_slow_start' rollout guard that combines fingerprint-consistency checks + tenant token-spend heat detection. If either trips during a ramp the rollout auto-pauses and emits a telemetry tag. Links to UI/ API below. Thoughts?

kishan: +1 on combining signals. How do you define fingerprint? full prompt hash or normalized prompt signature? :thinking:

anya: Thinking normalized prompt signature (strip timestamps, user ids, ephemeral metadata) then  sha1 of the normalized text. We compare distribution of top-10 fingerprints across baseline vs canary. If top-10 overlap < 60% => drift.

maria: 60% overlap seems a bit tight for multi-tenant apps. Maybe make overlap threshold configurable per-tenant tier. Also need to avoid false positives for experiments (A/B where prompts intentionally differ).

samir: Agreed. Also add latency and error SLO bands as separate signals. We shouldn't conflate drift with transient noise. Proposal: require either (fingerprint_drift && error_rate_delta > 0.5x SLO) OR (token_spend_rate > spend_threshold) to pause.

jess: For token_spend_rate: do we mean tokens/sec or cost/sec? Tenants that call embeddings will look different. We should normalize to cost-per-minute using our pricing model so it's comparable across endpoints.

anya: Good call. Use normalized cost-per-minute. Config example (pseudo):
```json
{ "type": "staged_slow_start", "phases": [ {"p":10, "duration":300}, {"p":50, "duration":900}, {"p":100, "duration":600} ], "signals": { "fingerprint_overlap_pct": 60, "error_rate_increase_pct": 50, "cost_spike_pct": 40 }, "cooldown": 900, "require": "(fingerprint_drift && error_rate_check) || cost_spike" }
```

kishan: Nice. A few API/contract questions: 1) how does the control plane get baseline fingerprints? from production telemetry snapshots or last-stable model snapshot? 2) time window for comparisons?

anya: Baseline = rolling window of last N successful requests from the pre-rollout production route (default 30m). Comparison window is the active canary window. All configurable.

maria: UX: Console should show a small sparkline of fingerprint overlap + top 5 differing fingerprints with example prompts (sanitized). Also show projected cost delta if current trend continues. That'll help PMs decide to unpause.

samir: Telemetry hooks: emit event tags: rollout.guard.triggered, rollout.guard.reason=[fingerprint|error|cost], rollout.guard.tenant_id, rollout.guard.phase. Also push raw counters to metrics: canary.fingerprint_overlap, canary.cost_per_min, canary.error_rate.

jess: We need to consider privacy: examples shown in console must be redacted. Maybe show tokenized length and pseudonymized prompt hash sample, not raw prompts.

anya: Agreed. Redact by default and allow customers opt-in to show examples for their own tenants.

kishan: What about rollback vs pause semantics? Is pause a reversible stop of traffic or an immediate rollback to baseline?

anya: Plan: pause = halt ramp and keep current split (stop increasing). If severe (error_rate > 5x SLO or total_cost_delta catastrophic) then automatic rollback to last stable model. Manual unpause path in console with a 'force continue' action and a mandatory reason/approval for enterprise tenants.

samir: Sounds reasonable. Add a canary-level cooldown counter so repeated fast resumes get stricter (exponential backoff on retries).

deploy-bot: deploy status: canary rollout 2026-06-15T09:08:45Z started for flow/v2 -> phase 1 (10%). monitoring hooks attached.

maria: For telemetry we should add a derived metric: 'canary.stability_score' = weighted( overlap_pct, 1 - error_delta_norm, 1 - cost_spike_norm ) so UI can show a single green/yellow/red indicator.

jess: Implementation note: runtime should tag requests with fingerprint header e.g. `X-RW-Fingerprint: <hash>` so the control plane can sample without peeking into payloads. That keeps path efficient.

anya: Exactly. Runtime will emit header, control plane samples and computes overlap. SDKs can opt-in to add fingerprint on client side for private deployments.

kishan: OK next steps: I'll draft an RFC for the API shape + console mockups. @anya can you stub telemetry event names and the panic thresholds? I'll start an infra spike to persist fingerprint aggregates.

anya: Thanks — will drop a short RFC in #eng-platform/rfcs today and ping you. :thumbsup:
